headline: Bank of England Expected to Raise Rates While Signaling Caution on Further Hikes
summary: The Bank of England is poised to raise interest rates but may push back against investor bets for further tightening.
why: Central bank interest rate decisions directly influence borrowing costs, currency valuations, and gilt yields across the United Kingdom economy.
why_moved: An anticipated rate hike directly alters monetary policy stances and currency expectations.
